name: astrabox-api-codegen
//: A package of one tool, existing only because it cannot live in frontend/. openapi-typescript emits through the TypeScript compiler API, which typescript@7 (the Go port the console builds with) does not ship; npm refuses to nest a conflicting peer, and legacy-peer-deps would disable peer checking across the whole console tree. Here the tool gets the typescript@5 it asks for and the console keeps its own compiler. The paths are fixed rather than parameterised: there is exactly one snapshot and exactly one generated client, and `make check-api-client` compares this script's output against the committed file.
